name: Sugar Hill Berry Farm, LLC
tagline: Sugar Hill Berry Farm, LLC at https://www.sugarhillberryfarm.com
description: In 237 Sugar Hill Road, VT, Sugar Hill Berry Farm, LLC raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
